results.TURN_EXPLAIN: Measured from the headset between the end of the 1.6 s hold window and the moment your head faces the walk home - head path through the turn, not foot pivot; feet are not tracked. Sweep-backs count reversals of the head's yaw sweep bigger than 5 deg. The dip is your lowest head height vs your walking baseline. Line re-acquisition is the time until you hold within 0.20 m of the centerline on the way home.
results.PRESENTATION_EXPLAIN_WITH_TURN: Composite read: all four measured channels blended, posture and rhythm weighted heaviest. It is not separately measured - your turn is analyzed separately in the TURN row and does not feed this score.
